title: TRICARE Select Paying After Other Health Insurance on Reprocessed Stays
content:
**Policy text.** What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a reprocessed **TRICARE Select** stay is its payable allowed amount less the beneficiary liability, never below zero. With other health insurance on file, the deductible and cost share of a reprocessed stay (its billed amount and allowed amount counted in proportion to the covered days, as its payable allowed amount is) are figured on the allowed amount net of the other insurer's payment, and where the other insurer paid on it TRICARE pays second: where the provider is non-network nonparticipating, TRICARE pays the lesser of what it would pay as primary payer and the charge the provider may bill the beneficiary (the billed amount, never more than the allowed amount plus the tier's balance-billing limit percentage) less the other insurer's payment, less the beneficiary liability; where the provider is participating, TRICARE pays the allowed amount less the other insurer's payment, less the beneficiary liability; otherwise TRICARE pays what it would pay as primary payer. Each figure is rounded to the cent and never below zero.

The balance-billing limit is 15 percent on every TRICARE Select tier. The billed amount and allowed amount are those of the reversed stay line counted in proportion to the covered days; the other insurer's payment is the one recorded on that line.

## Input - judgement - output (hypothetical: 10 days billed, 5 covered, inpatient mental health stay; billed 12000.00, allowed 10000.00, other insurer paid 2000.00, liability 0.00)

- Proportional figures: billed 6000.00, payable allowed amount 5000.00; primary-payer amount 5000.00.
- Participating facility: 5000.00 less 2000.00, that is 3000.00.
- Nonparticipating facility: the proportional billed amount of 6000.00 is capped at 5750.00 (5000.00 plus 15 percent); 5750.00 less 2000.00 is 3750.00; the lesser of 5000.00 and 3750.00: 3750.00.
- Other insurer paid nothing: 5000.00.
